scope: Primary-source contract audit. No author simulator/RTL was obtained or executed; no root source, routes, model data or sealed studies modified.
main_result: NVLLM documents digital dot-product lanes, internal segment accumulation and ECC readiness, but does not disclose enough input/context/output ISA to establish independent expert-private inputs, exported INT32 partials or arbitrary partial readiness. Conduit uses bulk-bitwise/shift-and-add IFP, not a native GEMV tile ISA; its advertised timing source remains restricted.

nvllm.version: arXiv2604.25699v2,2026-08-04; DAC2026 DOI10.1145/3770743.3804190; author-prepared preprint with supplementary discussion.

verified_from_text.fact: k*k planes form one cluster, share peripheral circuitry and synchronously return PB rows. Evaluation uses2*2-plane clusters. Plane PBs feed cluster FIFO and per-lane segment buffers.

One complete weight column w and activation vector a are divided into segments of factor d. Accumulator s starts at0; pointer starts at0; correct segments accumulate, faulty segments are recorded/corrected and subsequently accumulated; the algorithm returns final s.

Each OoO-ECDP contains2*d-wide segment buffer, inline checker, mixed-precision MAC and commit/scoreboard interface. Readiness refers to error checking/correction. Final accumulation follows in-order completion of weight columns.
Prefetch is per cluster/per layer, based on segment deadlines, with contiguous FFN weights across clusters. No random-read predictor or cross-expert context ISA is specified.
A cluster-level bitmap can adjust complete weight-column work between NAND and NPU as KV attention latency changes.
Base system has32planes/8clusters,16KiB PBs and modeled5.12us read. The16C comparison uses64planes/16clusters. Plane timing is modeled with3D-FPIM; C++ system model incorporates NAND and DRAM models.
Verilog HDL synthesized with TSMC28nm; NAND side has512KiB cache FIFO,72KiB global buffer,16KiB activation buffer and a RISC-V coordinator.

One NAND Activation Buffer is shown. Each depicted PE lane shows MAC Unit0/1, with16 a_i*b_i products in an adder tree; bias/accumulator selection depends on ptr reaching len(w)-1. Figure does not label accumulator width, scale, returned format or expert/context ID.
NAND OoO-ECDP counts8/12/16; NPU4 without ECC; NAND350MHz and NPU500MHz; total307-486GOPS.

throughput_reconstruction.status: Inference matching published figure/table/total GOPS, not RTL or lane-interface validation.
throughput_reconstruction.assumption: Interpret Figure5 as two16-product MAC units per ECDP, each accepting one product per multiplier per cycle; count one multiply and one add as2operations.
throughput_reconstruction.boundary: This reconstructs aggregate peak arithmetic throughput. It does not prove real sustained bandwidth, segment/codeword bit count, issue freedom or independent activation contexts. Do not substitute AiF ECC bandwidth for this MAC model.

not_disclosed_or_not_proven: Per-plane independent inputs: contradicted as a general plane-resource assumption by shared synchronous cluster periphery; no per-plane compute context was disclosed.
Different expert-private activations concurrently on different clusters/lanes: not established. Shared activation storage and multiple lanes are not proof of independently addressable contexts.
Precise d units for the physical ECC codeword and bit-level encoding, FIFO depth per cluster, scoreboard/commit entry count and corrector service/queue timing.
Architectural opcodes, descriptor fields, accumulator reset signal, arbitrary vector-length/subrange programming and weight programmer/address map.
Accumulator width, signed arithmetic/saturation/widening rules, scaling, rounding or returned INT32/FP32 format.
Export of a single internal segment partial or partial-column result for host merging.
Early output-row readiness visible to a GU->activation->down scheduler, or a fully specified nonlinear-activation interface.
Rerunning another input against resident PB/FIFO weights without another array read.
nvllm.safe_expression_boundary: The paper expresses full-column dot products from internal segments; whole output columns can be distributed under its existing scheduler. It does not establish an external page-dot primitive with known numeric merge. Its ECC OoO is not a license to introduce arbitrary multi-expert contexts.
nvllm.public_artifact_status: No matching author repository or downloadable NVLLM functional/timing source found in paper links or bounded exact-title/author/GitHub searches. The paper links upstream3D-FPIM/Ramulator-style components, which are not its unpublished integrated simulator or RTL. SlugLab/HBFSim is a third-party collector, not an NVLLM implementation.
nvllm.maturity: Published simulated/synthesized architecture. No manufactured NVLLM silicon is claimed.

verified_from_text.fact: Independent dies contain planes sharing periphery; same-die multi-plane operations require same page offset. IFP uses Flash-Cosmos multi-wordline sensing and Ares-Flash PB-latch arithmetic.
LLVM12 vectorization forces4096 elements of32bits=16KiB, with instruction metadata for pointers, element sizes and vector length.
Runtime splits vectors for narrower DRAM/controller widths, tracks dependencies and dispatches independent instructions concurrently to controller, DRAM and flash execution queues.
ISP uses ARM MVE; PuD uses SIMDRAM/MIMDRAM/Proteus bbop-style ISA; IFP uses Flash-Cosmos MWS and Ares-Flash shift_and_add.

FTL enforces operand locality/alignment, e.g. Flash-Cosmos AND operands in the same block. Inter-resource movement uses existing reads/DMA. Lazy coherence can retain modified results in DRAM/PBs/registers until required elsewhere or evicted.
Computation mode suspends host I/O; GC/wear leveling still run. Do not add unmodeled concurrent host traffic as though it were the evaluated native mode.

Firmware framework runs on assumed prior NDP hardware. Its model extends MQSim/Ramulator/QEMU with per-resource queues, operand movement and computation cost models; it is not a manufactured SSD implementing all these functions.

Evaluation table uses4KiB physical flash pages, while vectorization discussion calls16KiB a typical aligned page. Keep this distinction explicit; do not silently treat each4096x32bit vector as one evaluated physical page.

conduit.numeric_boundary: 32-bit vector operands are a compiler/data-size setting, not proof of a raw INT32 GEMV return contract. No native GEMV tile opcode, fixed INT8 dot-product ABI, rounding contract or functional MoE numeric executor was established. Controller/DRAM operations must not be called in-flash computation.

artifact_check.public_description: Advertises a SimPy trace timing simulator with FTL/Core/Flash/DRAM, latency functions and operation/resource counters. No weight/output execution is advertised in that description.
artifact_check.conclusion: Public metadata/README descriptions are available; simulator files are not publicly downloadable through the checked records. No source or numeric result validation was performed. No matching author GitHub release verified.

conduit.placement_boundary: Operand co-location can change native bitwise/arithmetic instruction and movement costs, but this is a different layout problem from page-GEMV row sharding. A valid MoE experiment needs a fully specified bit-sliced arithmetic lowering and all temporary movements/writes; the public Conduit descriptions do not supply that executable contract.

concrete_experiment_gate.reason: Neither target currently gives a public, sufficiently specified native multi-context page-GEMV contract that permits a new large-placement experiment without additional assumptions.
concrete_experiment_gate.safe_small_reconstruction: One may reimplement NVLLM Algorithm1 for complete columns and reconstruct the aggregate PE-throughput ceiling above, holding one active activation vector per engine and using ordinary synchronized4-plane reads. Label it a paper-derived semantic/cost model, not an executed author backend. It calibrates a different backend but does not itself establish a new placement mechanism.
forbidden_shortcuts: Assume each NVLLM plane gets a different x.
Treat ECC OoO as arbitrary expert OoO.
Expose internal segment sums as rawI32 without a disclosed output mode.
Claim Conduit public files were executed from its restricted README.
Port AiF read/MAC timing to either backend.

system_contribution_assessment.generic_representability_not_a_rejection: A problem being representable as declustering, discrepancy, DP or generic DAG mapping does not rule out a systems contribution. The preceding mask theorems constrain those particular claims, not the entire compiler project.
system_contribution_assessment.potential_claim: Ordinary-read IFP whole-row semantic preservation, exact work/depth geometry compilation, physical address/command certificates and strong matched native controls can form a coherent systems claim without claiming first DP or first joint mapping.
system_contribution_assessment.most_important_missing_research_content: A reusable, nontrivial legal-lowering/geometry mechanism whose practical benefit remains after best-width, unequal-row, dense block packing and same-scheduler controls, on more than an isolated shape. Certificates establish correctness; the measured surviving mechanism establishes the research contribution.
system_contribution_assessment.whole_row_numeric_contract: Whole-row sharding can be proved against an opaque existing native row function F: preserve the complete row bytes/metadata, full input dimension and vector, per-row quantization metadata, then only scatter outputs. This does not require exported rawI32, unlike column splitting. It remains necessary to prove that command boundaries/addressing preserve that row function on the selected backend.
system_contribution_assessment.direct_prior_status: No examined primary source directly supplies the same ordinary-NAND whole-row integer-wave geometry compiler plus physical/numerical certificate. This is a bounded literature finding, not a priority claim; Cambricon-FlexLLM/DIAMoND full texts remain unavailable.
closest_specific_priors: AiF ISCA2025 section5.2 describes equal-sized matrix shards in sequential IFP blocks and cross-block suboperations; it already establishes placement and command machinery, but the examined text does not derive unequal whole-row integer-wave optimization.
Cambricon-LLM MICRO2024 sectionV derives2D page-sized atomic tiles and input/result-optimal aspect ratios; this is a direct NAND geometry/transfer prior, not the same whole-row numeric lowering.
SLIM neuron/page packing and fused sparse FFN are direct adjacent layout prior; do not present generic page alignment, even distribution or GU/down correspondence as new.
NVLLM sections3.1-3.4 optimize cluster-lane delivery and ECC-ready segments rather than the specified whole-row compiler.
Conduit sections4.3-4.4 vectorizes page-aligned operations and enforces data-placement constraints but uses a different bitwise/shift-add IFP primitive.
system_contribution_assessment.adjacent_system_precedent: TileLens arXiv2607.04031v1 introduction describes transparent configurable tile-major layout compilation for GPU/HBF. It supports evaluating the contribution at the system/compiler level rather than treating generic layout representability as fatal. It also has new TMA/cache/prefetch hardware, so those mechanisms cannot be imported into this existing-hardware-only project.
system_contribution_assessment.tilelens_read_depth: Abstract and introduction only; no full methods/artifact audit in this round.
